insights.summary: The agent performed a highly successful optimization of the vLLM evictor module. It achieved a 13x speedup on V1 and a 124x speedup on V2 by replacing inefficient OrderedDict iterations with a min-heap and lazy deletion strategy. The agent demonstrated strong code comprehension and engineering judgment, particularly in implementing a memory cleanup threshold.
strengths: High-quality implementation of the priority queue pattern.
Strong self-correction when test scripts failed.
weaknesses: Poor git hygiene; the final patch was polluted with thousands of unrelated file deletions from the worktree state.
Initial attempt to write a file failed because it hadn't been 'read' yet (tool constraint violation).
